semantics.nullVsZero: null means source coverage is unknown/unavailable for that metric/date; 0 means the date is covered and the measured count/duration is zero
semantics.airAlertSeconds: net seconds during which the exact canonical city was under an applicable air alert on the Europe/Kyiv calendar date; overlapping oblast/raion/hromada alerts are unioned upstream
semantics.explosionReports: number of Air-alarms.in.ua media/OSINT reports of explosions attributed to the exact canonical city; not a physical explosion count, not a missile/drone hit count, and not an oblast total

airAlertSeconds.inputRepresentation: sparse city/day rows; missing city/day inside covered interval means covered zero alert seconds
